summary: Casella Waste Systems filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Master Lease Agreement with Huntington National Bank for leasing motor vehicles and equipment. The filing describes an uncommitted $20M interim financing facility and a $250M board-approved aggregate lease limit. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or any event-driven special situation is present. This is a routine financing arrangement for operational equipment, not a change-of-control or shareholder referendum event.
